name: PostHog
look: One continuous warm cream sheet, a single yellow-orange pill with olive text, and hand-drawn mascots as the whole decorative system.

hero.title: Product analytics without the four vendors
hero.sub: Analytics, session replay, feature flags, experiments and surveys on one set of events. Generous free tier, and the whole thing is open source.

features.title: Six products, one event stream
features.sub: Every tool reads the same events, so a flag, a replay and a funnel all agree about what happened.

items.title: Product analytics
items.body: Funnels, retention and paths over your own events, with SQL underneath when the UI runs out.

items.title: Session replay
items.body: Watch the actual session behind a drop-off, with console and network attached.

items.title: Feature flags
items.body: Roll out by cohort, kill instantly, and see the effect in the same tool.

items.title: Experiments
items.body: A/B tests using the flags you already have, with significance calculated honestly.

items.title: Surveys
items.body: Ask the users who did the thing, targeted by the same cohorts.

items.title: Your data warehouse
items.body: Sync to or from your warehouse; the events are yours in a queryable table.

showcases.title: The tools stop disagreeing
showcases.body: Four vendors means four definitions of an active user and four SDKs racing on page load. One event stream means the funnel, the replay and the flag are all describing the same session.
points: One SDK and one event definition
Replay linked from any funnel step

showcases.title: Read it, run it, or leave with it
showcases.body: The whole platform is open source and self-hostable. Most teams use the cloud, but the option is what makes the pricing honest — the exit is real rather than theoretical.
points: Full platform, not an open core
Export every event at any time

gallery.title: Documentation
gallery.sub: Getting started, SDKs, self-hosting and the SQL layer.

testimonial.quote: We cancelled three subscriptions and stopped arguing in standup about whose dashboard was right. That second thing was worth more than the money.
testimonial.name: Ellie Mbeki

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.sub: Generous free tier, then usage-based with the rates published.

items.q: Is the free tier a trial?
items.a: No. A million events a month, permanently, across all six products. Plenty of small products never pay anything.
No. Invite your whole company; you pay for events and replays, not for people looking at them.
Yes, the entire platform, not an open-core subset. Docker Compose for small deployments and Kubernetes charts for larger ones.
In the cloud region you pick, EU or US, and it never moves between them. Self-hosting keeps it entirely on your own infrastructure.

cta.title: Start with a million free events
cta.sub: No card, no seat pricing, all six products.

footer.tagline: Product analytics without the four vendors.

notes: The warm cream canvas runs end to end with no surface alternation — the page is one continuous sheet.
A single yellow-orange pill with deep olive text is the only saturated colour in the system.
One typeface across every text role, at five weights. There is no second family.
Hand-drawn mascots scattered through the layout are the entire decorative system — no gradients, no mesh, no atmospherics.
Pastel callout banners with soft tinted side rails break up long documentation copy for tips and warnings.
